contentText:
Karol G continues to stay on top of the Billboard Hot Latin Songs top 10 chart with “Bby Wow.” Bad Bunny and Karol G continue to be dominate forces on the chart.

Here’s the Billboard Hot Latin Songs top 10 for the week dated September 19th. Lenin Ramirez crashes into the top 10 with “Polvo Rosita,” Neton Vega slides to 9. Latin Mafia and Fred Again.. push up to 8, as does Jay Wheeler to 7. “Koko” moves to 6 and “Ayúdame” to 5, “Matadora” claims the No. 4 spot, Karol G and Drake take No. 3, while “DtMF” holds the line at No. 2 and “Bby Wow” continues running the show with a fourth week at No. 1!
